title: Model Evaluation and Debugging
prompt: How would you evaluate a machine-learning model before using it downstream? Explain how you would choose between precision and recall, validate performance in production, investigate an accuracy drop, and handle class imbalance. How would you tune and validate hyperparameters?

response.placeholder: Define the decision and evaluation metric, then explain validation, diagnosis, class imbalance, and tuning.
response.reference_answer:
## Evaluation contract

Start with the downstream decision, available labels, and cost of different errors. Choose precision, recall, or a cost-based metric accordingly, and examine thresholds and calibration rather than relying on accuracy alone. Keep a representative holdout with relevant time, user, or group boundaries; check leakage and label quality.

## Production validation

Compare a candidate against a baseline on the same examples and meaningful slices. Where appropriate, use shadow or limited traffic to measure quality and operational behavior before wider release. Define success and stopping criteria in advance, including latency, missing features, and delayed outcomes.

## Investigating an accuracy drop

Check whether traffic, labels, evaluation code, data joins, schemas, features, or serving configuration changed. Compare score distributions and affected slices; test a specific hypothesis before attributing the issue to model weights. Use versioned data and configurations to reproduce the change.

## Class imbalance

Measure per-class and decision-relevant outcomes. Compare threshold changes, weighting, or sampling against a simple baseline using untouched representative validation data. A better aggregate score can hide a worse outcome for one class; the appropriate tradeoff depends on the product's error costs.

## Hyperparameter tuning

Choose a validation scheme reflecting deployment, isolate the final test set, and tune against the decision metric within a stated compute budget. Account for leakage and variability across runs. Recheck the selected configuration on held-out data and monitor performance after deployment.
